description: 5V-to-3.3V regulated power supply board with enable control

U1.notes: Enable pin must be pulled HIGH (3.3V-5V) for the regulator to output voltage. If EN is pulled LOW or floating, output will read near 0V even with correct input voltage.

TP2.description: Enable control signal; must be HIGH for regulator to work

TP3.description: Regulated output voltage, powers the rest of the board

known_fault_for_demo.root_cause: R1 pull-up resistor is missing/disconnected, leaving U1's ENABLE pin floating LOW instead of pulled HIGH
diagnostic_path: Check TP1 (input) — should read 5V, confirms input power is fine
Check TP2 (enable pin) — will read near 0V, revealing the actual fault
Conclusion: regulator is disabled because ENABLE isn't being pulled high
